concerns.text: SC-002 uses the *adjusted R² of the Linear Mixed‑Effects Model (full fit)* as a validation target, but this metric is computed on the same data used to fit the model, making it dependent on the predictor variables. Comparing an in‑sample R² to an out‑of‑sample RF R² creates a circular validation of the nutrient‑architecture relationship.

The specification provides no power or sample‑size justification for detecting the expected associations. Without an a priori power analysis, it is unclear whether the post‑filtering sample (≥20 observations per species) yields sufficient statistical power for the LMM and RF comparisons.

Excluding entire species when a single nutrient measurement is missing (as required by FR‑009) can introduce selection bias, potentially inflating effect estimates and compromising the generality of the reported associations. The plan should discuss bias implications or propose an alternative handling strategy (e.g., partial imputation).
